decisions.reason: As a close extension of our established enterprise messaging offer with its own public product page and clear fit with our broader cloud-communications strategy, we would keep it and view any early underperformance as temporary given the investment already made.

Because this product is also close to our core secure communication services, has been publicly committed to on the website, and supports the announced direction toward integrated multichannel enterprise workflows, we would keep it rather than reverse course after such a recent launch.
